# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
When the EMA ribbon (8,21,55) compresses tightly for several bars, a break below the compression low signals short‑side momentum. This captures exhaustion after low-volatility consolidation, distinct from rejection-candle triggers already in the registry.

## Mechanism
Calculate ribbon width as (highest EMA − lowest EMA) / close. If width < 0.002 (0.2%) for three consecutive 5‑minute bars, enter short on the first 5‑minute bar closing below the lowest EMA of the compression band. Exit: chart‑stop at swing high above compression band, TP1 at 1×R, runner trail using chandelier exit (ATR×3). Regime filters: VIX > 18, time 10:00‑12:00 ET, no higher high/higher low in last 20 bars (chop condition).
